turns.replyText:
Can I pay in installments or split payment?

You may be able to, yes, but it’s handled through the installment provider, not directly by us.

Here’s how it works:

• If installment options (like Affirm, Shop Pay Installments, Klarna, etc.) are available for your order, you’ll see them as choices at checkout when you enter your payment details. • Any payment schedule, interest, or splitting into multiple payments is completely managed by that provider. • We don’t have access to change which card or bank account is used, how many payments you make, or your due dates.

If you want to change anything about an existing installment plan (like switching cards or adjusting dates), please contact the installment provider directly. Their contact details will be in the confirmation email they sent you when you set up the plan.
